model.title: Non-road mobile machinery engines: inclusion of hydrogen as a reference fuel for the testing of an engine type or engine family

summary.text: This proposal would modify existing rules for testing engines to allow hydrogen to be used as an alternative fuel option during these tests. The change aims to help evaluate how engines perform when running on hydrogen fuel.
